tools.name: finalize_asset
tools.description: Finalize an authored collection, or a batch of requests, through every step into the Godot project: exports .glb Desktop and Mobile variants under export_root (default <project>/game/assets), runs godot --headless --import once and probes each variant against its nmg-asset.json (import_godot), and imports one animation .glb per rig clip as a Godot animation library (import_anims). Failures carry a code and remediation, e.g. godot.not_found, import_godot.project_missing, import_godot.import_failed, import_godot.mismatch, import_godot.terrain_height_mismatch. Pass exactly one of collection or requests, a list of finalize requests that run one at a time in order under one job lock; the top-level options fill in any key a request omits. fail_fast skips the rest of a batch after a failure, otherwise the rest still run. wait_for_lock waits for another finalize job to release the lock, for at most lock_wait_seconds, instead of failing with finalize.job_running. compatible_with lists <Category>/<Name> characters whose Desktop skeleton must hold every bone the clips animate. Returns {job_id, status} at once; includes the result when the job finishes within wait_seconds (0-150), and for a batch result.batch lists each collection's state with succeeded, failed, and skipped counts.

export_root.description: Directory the variants are written under, inside the Godot project. Defaults to <project>/game/assets.

requests.description: A batch: finalize request objects with the collection keys (collection, category, asset_class, export_root, blend, budgets_path, device, compatible_with, material_variants_path). Exclusive with collection.

tools.name: run_finalize_step
tools.description: Run one finalize step (validate, bake, variants, export, export_anims, reimport, import_godot, or import_anims) through the same implementation finalize_asset uses; the steps it depends on run first, from the cache when they are there. export_root defaults to <project>/game/assets. Returns {job_id, status} at once, or the finished result within wait_seconds (0-150). wait_for_lock and lock_wait_seconds bound the wait for another job's lock.

export_root.description: Directory the variants are written under, inside the Godot project. Defaults to <project>/game/assets.

tools.name: reduce_asset
tools.description: Reduce a generated collection to its Desktop triangle budget and bake its look onto the reduced mesh (#139). The originals move to the hidden <Name>_High collection. Returns {job_id, status} at once; includes the result when the job finishes within wait_seconds (0-150). terrain is refused.

asset_class.description: small_prop, standard_prop, hero_prop, character, or environment_piece. Any other value, including terrain, is refused with reduce.class_unsupported.

tools.name: import_audio
tools.description: Import a saved ElevenLabs sound effect or music file into the Godot project. Stores a 16-bit WAV under SourceArt/Audio/<SFX|Music>/. A sound effect is copied to game/assets/Audio/<name>.wav and imported as an AudioStreamWAV; music is encoded with ffmpeg to game/assets/Audio/<name>.ogg and imported as an AudioStreamOggVorbis (looping when loop is true). The result names godot_asset and imported_to_godot; without Godot it reports imported_to_godot false with a warning. Returns the result, or an error object (e.g. audio.ffmpeg_not_found).

tools.name: game_screenshot
tools.description: Save a PNG of the running consumer game after a delay, so an asset can be reviewed under the game's own lighting and materials. Runs the Godot project in a window with the launch options and NmgLaunch's --nmg-shot flag: the root viewport is written to path and the game quits. A relative path resolves against the consumer project. Returns {path, width, height}, or an error object with shot.invalid_after, godot.project_missing, godot.not_found, or shot.no_image (the game exited without writing the PNG; the message carries its last output lines).

path.description: Where to write the PNG. A relative path resolves against the consumer project.

options.description: Launch options for the game, for example ["--at=Forest", "--hour=18"].

tools.name: get_finalize_job
tools.description: Return a finalize job's state, step, progress, message, batch progress (total, completed, current collection and index, and each item's state), and result or error. An unknown id returns finalize.job_not_found.

tools.name: list_material_variants
tools.description: List a finalized asset's material variants for Desktop and Mobile from the files finalize wrote, without starting Godot. Reads <export_root>/<Category>/<Name>/nmg-variants.json (export_root defaults to <project>/game/assets) and returns rows of {name, material, desktop, mobile} sorted by material then name, where desktop and mobile are the res:// path of the variant's .tres material or null. An asset with no material variants returns []; a missing or invalid sidecar returns finalize.material_variants_failed.
